verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּקְרַ֖ע אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יו וַיִּתְכַּ֣ס בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיָּבֹ֖א בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ham·me·leḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū way·yiq·ra‘ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yiṯ·kas baś·śāq way·yā·ḇō bêṯ Yah·weh
verses.literal: On hearing this report King Hezekiah tore his clothes put on sackcloth and entered the house of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E ACONTECEU que, tendo Ezequias ouvido isto, rasgou as suas vestes, e se cobriu de saco, e entrou na casa do SENHOR.

verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח אֶת־ אֶלְיָקִ֨ים אֲשֶׁר־ עַל־ הַבַּ֜יִת וְשֶׁבְנָ֣א הַסֹּפֵ֗ר וְאֵת֙ זִקְנֵ֣י הַכֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים מִתְכַּסִּ֖ים בַּשַּׂקִּ֑ים אֶל־ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא בֶּן־ אָמֽוֹץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’eṯ- ’el·yā·qîm ’ă·šer- ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·šeḇ·nā has·sō·p̄êr wə·’êṯ ziq·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm miṯ·kas·sîm baś·śaq·qîm ’el- yə·ša‘·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî ben- ’ā·mō·wṣ
verses.literal: And he sent Eliakim the palace administrator Shebna the scribe and the leading priests all wearing sackcloth to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz
verses.literalPt: Então enviou a Eliaquim, o mordomo, e a Sebna, o escrivão, e os anciãos dos sacerdotes, cobertos de sacos, ao profeta Isaías, filho de Amós.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר חִזְקִיָּ֔הוּ יוֹם־ צָרָ֧ה וְתוֹכֵחָ֛ה וּנְאָצָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י בָ֤אוּ בָנִים֙ עַד־ מַשְׁבֵּ֔ר וְכֹ֥חַ אַ֖יִן לְלֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw kōh ’ā·mar ḥiz·qî·yā·hū yō·wm- ṣā·rāh wə·ṯō·w·ḵê·ḥāh ū·nə·’ā·ṣāh hay·yō·wm haz·zeh kî ḇā·’ū ḇā·nîm ‘aḏ- maš·bêr wə·ḵō·aḥ ’a·yin lə·lê·ḏāh
verses.literal: to tell him This is what Hezekiah says Today . . . is a day of distress rebuke and disgrace for children have come to the point of birth but there is no strength to deliver them
verses.literalPt: E disseram-lhe: Assim diz Ezequias: Este dia é dia de angústia, de vituperação e de blasfêmia; porque os filhos chegaram ao parto, e não há força para dá-los à luz.

verses.original: אוּלַ֡י יִשְׁמַע֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י רַב־ שָׁקֵ֗ה אֲשֶׁר֩ שְׁלָח֨וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֤וּר׀ אֲדֹנָיו֙ לְחָרֵף֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים חַ֔י וְהוֹכִ֙יחַ֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמַ֖ע יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְנָשָׂ֣אתָ תְפִלָּ֔ה בְּעַ֥ד הַשְּׁאֵרִ֖ית הַנִּמְצָאָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ū·lay yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê raḇ- šā·qêh ’ă·šer šə·lā·ḥōw me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ’ă·ḏō·nāw lə·ḥā·rêp̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥay wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ bad·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·ma‘ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·nā·śā·ṯā ṯə·p̄il·lāh bə·‘aḏ haš·šə·’ê·rîṯ han·nim·ṣā·’āh
verses.literal: Perhaps the LORD your God will hear all the words of the Rabshakeh whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to defy the living God and He will rebuke him for the words that the LORD your God has heard Therefore lift up a prayer for the remnant that still survives
verses.literalPt: Bem pode ser que o SENHOR teu Deus ouça todas as palavras de Rabsaqué, a quem enviou o seu SENHOR, o rei da Assíria, para afrontar o Deus vivo, e para vituperá-lo com as palavras que o SENHOR teu Deus tem ouvido; faze, pois, oração pelo restante que subsiste.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֗אוּ עַבְדֵ֛י הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ אֶל־ יְשַֽׁעַיָֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḇ·ḏê ham·me·leḵ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’el- yə·ša·‘a·yā·hū
verses.literal: So the servants of King Hezekiah went to Isaiah
verses.literalPt: E os servos do rei Ezequias foram a Isaías.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לָהֶם֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ כֹּ֥ה תֹאמְר֖וּן אֶל־ אֲדֹֽנֵיכֶ֑ם כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־ תִּירָא֙ מִפְּנֵ֤י הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֲשֶׁ֧ר גִּדְּפ֛וּ נַעֲרֵ֥י מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר אֹתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lā·hem yə·ša‘·yā·hū kōh ṯō·mə·rūn ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nê·ḵem kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’al- tî·rā mip·pə·nê had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·ma‘·tā ’ă·šer gid·də·p̄ū na·‘ă·rê me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr ’ō·ṯî
verses.literal: who replied Tell . . . your master . . . that this is what the LORD says Do not be afraid of the words you have heard with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me
verses.literalPt: E Isaías lhes disse: Assim direis a vosso senhor: Assim diz o SENHOR: Não temas as palavras que ouviste, com as quais os servos do rei da Assíria me blasfemaram.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן בּוֹ֙ ר֔וּחַ וְשָׁמַ֥ע שְׁמוּעָ֖ה וְשָׁ֣ב לְאַרְצ֑וֹ וְהִפַּלְתִּ֥יו בַּחֶ֖רֶב בְּאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî nō·ṯên bōw rū·aḥ wə·šā·ma‘ šə·mū·‘āh wə·šāḇ lə·’ar·ṣōw wə·hip·pal·tîw ba·ḥe·reḇ bə·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: Behold I will put a spirit in him so that he will hear a rumor and return to his own land where I will cause him to fall by the sword
verses.literalPt: Eis que porei nele um espírito, e ele ouvirá um rumor, e voltará para a sua terra; à espada o farei cair na sua terra.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ רַב־ שָׁקֵ֔ה וַיִּמְצָא֙ אֶת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר נִלְחָ֖ם עַל־ לִבְנָ֑ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י נָסַ֖ע מִלָּכִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šāḇ raḇ- šā·qêh way·yim·ṣā ’eṯ- me·leḵ ’aš·šūr nil·ḥām ‘al- liḇ·nāh kî šā·ma‘ kî nā·sa‘ mil·lā·ḵîš
verses.literal: When the Rabshakeh heard that the king of Assyria had left Lachish he withdrew and found the king fighting against Libnah
verses.literalPt: Voltou, pois, Rabsaqué, e achou o rei da Assíria pelejando contra Libna, porque tinha ouvido que o rei havia partido de Laquis.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֗ע אֶל־ תִּרְהָ֤קָה מֶֽלֶך־ כּוּשׁ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֥ה יָצָ֖א לְהִלָּחֵ֣ם אִתָּ֑ךְ וַיָּ֙שָׁב֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ’el- tir·hā·qāh me·leḵ- kūš lê·mōr hin·nêh yā·ṣā lə·hil·lā·ḥêm ’it·tāḵ way·yā·šāḇ way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lê·mōr
verses.literal: Now Sennacherib had been warned about Tirhakah king of Cush Look he has set out to fight against you So Sennacherib again sent messengers to Hezekiah saying
verses.literalPt: E, ouvindo ele dizer de Tiraca, rei da Etiópia: Eis que saiu para te fazer guerra; tornou a enviar mensageiros a Ezequias, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה תֹאמְר֗וּן אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֤הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַל־ יַשִּׁאֲךָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בֹּטֵ֥חַ בּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א תִנָּתֵן֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם בְּיַ֖ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ṯō·mə·rūn ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū me·leḵ- yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr ’al- yaš·ši·’ă·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bō·ṭê·aḥ bōw lê·mōr lō ṯin·nā·ṯên yə·rū·šā·lim bə·yaḏ me·leḵ ’aš·šūr
verses.literal: Give this message . . . to Hezekiah king of Judah Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you by saying that Jerusalem will not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Assim falareis a Ezequias, rei de Judá: Não te engane o teu Deus, em quem confias, dizendo: Jerusalém não será entregue na mão do rei da Assíria.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשׂ֜וּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר לְכָל־ הָאֲרָצ֖וֹת לְהַֽחֲרִימָ֑ם וְאַתָּ֖ה תִּנָּצֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ’at·tāh šā·ma‘·tā ’êṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ lə·ha·ḥă·rî·mām wə·’at·tāh tin·nā·ṣêl
verses.literal: Surely you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all the other countries devoting them to destruction Will you then be spared
verses.literalPt: Eis que já tens ouvido o que fizeram os reis da Assíria a todas as terras, destruindo-as totalmente; e tu, te livrarás?

verses.original: הַהִצִּ֨ילוּ אֹתָ֜ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁחֲת֣וּ אֲבוֹתַ֔י אֶת־ גּוֹזָ֖ן וְאֶת־ חָרָ֑ן וְרֶ֥צֶף וּבְנֵי־ עֶ֖דֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּתְלַאשָּֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hiṣ·ṣî·lū ’ō·ṯām ’ĕ·lō·hê hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ši·ḥă·ṯū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯay ’eṯ- gō·w·zān wə·’eṯ- ḥā·rān wə·re·ṣep̄ ū·ḇə·nê- ‘e·ḏen ’ă·šer biṯ·laś·śār
verses.literal: Did the gods of the nations destroyed by my fathers rescue those nations the gods of Gozan Haran and Rezeph and of the people of Eden in Telassar
verses.literalPt: Porventura as livraram os deuses das nações, a quem meus pais destruíram, como a Gozã, a Harã, a Resefe, e aos filhos de Éden, que estavam em Telassar?

verses.original: אַיּ֤וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־ חֲמָת֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ אַרְפָּ֔ד וּמֶ֖לֶךְ לָעִ֣יר סְפַרְוָ֑יִם הֵנַ֖ע וְעִוָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ay·yōw me·leḵ- ḥă·māṯ ū·me·leḵ ’ar·pāḏ ū·me·leḵ lā·‘îr sə·p̄ar·wā·yim hê·na‘ wə·‘iw·wāh
verses.literal: Where are the kings of Hamath Arpad Sepharvaim Hena and Ivvah
verses.literalPt: Que é feito do rei de Hamate, do rei de Arpade, e do rei da cidade de Sefarvaim, Hena e Iva?

verses.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חִזְקִיָּ֧הוּ אֶת־ הַסְּפָרִ֛ים מִיַּ֥ד הַמַּלְאָכִ֖ים וַיִּקְרָאֵ֑ם וַיַּ֙עַל֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּפְרְשֵׂ֥הוּ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ḥiz·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- has·sə·p̄ā·rîm mî·yaḏ ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yiq·rā·’êm way·ya·‘al bêṯ Yah·weh way·yip̄·rə·śê·hū ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers read it and went up to the house of the LORD and spread it out . . . before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Recebendo, pois, Ezequias as cartas das mãos dos mensageiros e lendo-as, subiu à casa do SENHOR; e Ezequias as estendeu perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל חִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים אַתָּה־ ה֤וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ לְבַדְּךָ֔ לְכֹ֖ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ אַתָּ֣ה עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṯ·pal·lêl ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yō·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl yō·šêḇ hak·kə·ru·ḇîm ’at·tāh- hū hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ḇad·də·ḵā lə·ḵōl mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’at·tāh ‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And Hezekiah prayed before the LORD . . . O LORD God of Israel enthroned between the cherubim You alone . . . are God over all the kingdoms of the earth You made the heavens and the earth
verses.literalPt: E orou Ezequias perante o SENHOR e disse: Ó SENHOR Deus de Israel, que habitas entre os querubins, tu mesmo, só tu és Deus de todos os reinos da terra; tu fizeste os céus e a terra.

verses.original: הַטֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה׀ אָזְנְךָ֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע פְּקַ֧ח יְהוָ֛ה עֵינֶ֖יךָ וּרְאֵ֑ה וּשְׁמַ֗ע אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י סַנְחֵרִ֔יב אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלָח֔וֹ לְחָרֵ֖ף אֱלֹהִ֥ים חָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ·ṭêh Yah·weh ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ū·šă·mā‘ pə·qaḥ Yah·weh ‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·rə·’êh ū·šə·ma‘ ’êṯ diḇ·rê san·ḥê·rîḇ ’ă·šer šə·lā·ḥōw lə·ḥā·rêp̄ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ḥāy
verses.literal: Incline Your ear O LORD and hear open Your eyes O LORD and see Listen to the words that Sennacherib has sent to defy the living God
verses.literalPt: Inclina, SENHOR, o teu ouvido, e ouve; abre, SENHOR, os teus olhos, e olha; e ouve as palavras de Senaqueribe, que enviou a este, para afrontar o Deus vivo.

verses.original: אָמְנָ֖ם יְהוָ֑ה הֶחֱרִ֜יבוּ מַלְכֵ֥י אַשּׁ֛וּר אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְאֶת־ אַרְצָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mə·nām Yah·weh he·ḥĕ·rî·ḇū mal·ḵê ’aš·šūr ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim wə·’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām
verses.literal: Truly O LORD the kings of Assyria have laid waste these nations and their lands
verses.literalPt: Verdade é, ó SENHOR, que os reis da Assíria assolaram as nações e as suas terras.

verses.original: וְנָתְנ֥וּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם בָּאֵ֑שׁ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֜ים הֵ֗מָּה כִּ֣י אִם־ מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה יְדֵֽי־ אָדָ֛ם עֵ֥ץ וָאֶ֖בֶן וַֽיְאַבְּדֽוּם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem bā·’êš kî lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm hêm·māh kî ’im- ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê- ’ā·ḏām ‘êṣ wā·’e·ḇen way·’ab·bə·ḏūm
verses.literal: They have cast their gods into the fire and destroyed them for they were not gods but only wood and stone the work of human hands
verses.literalPt: E lançaram os seus deuses no fogo; porquanto não eram deuses, mas obra de mãos de homens, madeira e pedra; por isso os destruíram.

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נוּ נָ֖א מִיָּד֑וֹ וְיֵֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־ מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū nā mî·yā·ḏōw wə·yê·ḏə·‘ū kāl- mam·lə·ḵō·wṯ hā·’ā·reṣ kî ’at·tāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·ḇad·de·ḵā
verses.literal: And now O LORD our God please save us from his hand so that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You alone O LORD are God
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, ó SENHOR nosso Deus, te suplico, livra-nos da sua mão; e assim saberão todos os reinos da terra que só tu és o SENHOR Deus.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ יְשַֽׁעְיָ֣הוּ בֶן־ אָמ֔וֹץ אֶל־ חִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ לֵאמֹ֑ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִתְפַּלַּ֧לְתָּ אֵלַ֛י אֶל־ סַנְחֵרִ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֖וּר שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yə·ša‘·yā·hū ḇen- ’ā·mō·wṣ ’el- ḥiz·qî·yā·hū lê·mōr kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer hiṯ·pal·lal·tā ’ê·lay ’el- san·ḥê·riḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr šā·mā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: Then Isaiah son of Amoz sent a message to Hezekiah This is what the LORD the God of Israel says I have heard your prayer concerning Sennacherib king of Assyria
verses.literalPt: Então Isaías, filho de Amós, mandou dizer a Ezequias: Assim diz o SENHOR Deus de Israel: O que me pediste acerca de Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, ouvi.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עָלָ֑יו בָּזָ֨ה לְךָ֜ לָעֲגָ֣ה לְךָ֗ בְּתוּלַת֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן אַחֲרֶ֙יךָ֙ רֹ֣אשׁ הֵנִ֔יעָה בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- dib·ber Yah·weh ‘ā·lāw bā·zāh lə·ḵā lā·‘ă·ḡāh lə·ḵā bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā rōš hê·nî·‘āh baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is the word that the LORD has spoken against him The Virgin Daughter of Zion despises you and mocks you the Daughter of Jerusalem shakes her head behind you
verses.literalPt: Esta é a palavra que o SENHOR falou dele: A virgem, a filha de Sião, te despreza, de ti zomba; a filha de Jerusalém meneia a cabeça por detrás de ti.

verses.original: אֶת־ מִ֤י חֵרַ֙פְתָּ֙ וְגִדַּ֔פְתָּ וְעַל־ מִ֖י הֲרִימ֣וֹתָ קּ֑וֹל וַתִּשָּׂ֥א מָר֛וֹם עֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- mî ḥê·rap̄·tā wə·ḡid·dap̄·tā wə·‘al- mî hă·rî·mō·w·ṯā qō·wl wat·tiś·śā mā·rō·wm ‘ê·ne·ḵā ‘al- qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Whom have you taunted and blasphemed Against whom have you raised your voice and lifted your eyes in pride Against the Holy One of Israel
verses.literalPt: A quem afrontaste e blasfemaste? E contra quem alçaste a voz e ergueste os teus olhos ao alto? Contra o Santo de Israel?

verses.original: בְּיַ֣ד מַלְאָכֶיךָ֮ חֵרַ֣פְתָּ׀ אֲדֹנָי֒ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר בְּרֶכֶב רִכְבִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י עָלִ֛יתִי מְר֥וֹם הָרִ֖ים יַרְכְּתֵ֣י לְבָנ֑וֹן וְאֶכְרֹ֞ת קוֹמַ֤ת אֲרָזָיו֙ מִבְח֣וֹר בְּרֹשָׁ֔יו וְאָב֙וֹאָה֙ מְל֣וֹן קִצֹּ֔ה יַ֖עַר כַּרְמִלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·yaḏ mal·’ā·ḵe·ḵā ḥê·rap̄·tā ’ă·ḏō·nāy wat·tō·mer bə·rɛ·ḵɛḇ riḵ·bî ’ă·nî ‘ā·lî·ṯî mə·rō·wm hā·rîm yar·kə·ṯê lə·ḇā·nō·wn wə·’eḵ·rōṯ qō·w·maṯ ’ă·rā·zāw miḇ·ḥō·wr bə·rō·šāw wə·’ā·ḇō·w·’āh mə·lō·wn qiṣ·ṣōh ya·‘ar kar·mil·lōw
verses.literal: Through your servants you have taunted the Lord and you have said With my many chariots I have ascended to the heights of the mountains to the remote peaks of Lebanon I have cut down its tallest cedars the finest of its cypresses I have reached its farthest outposts the densest of its forests
verses.literalPt: Por meio de teus mensageiros afrontaste o Senhor, e disseste: Com a multidão de meus carros subi ao alto dos montes, aos lados do Líbano, e cortarei os seus altos cedros e as suas mais formosas faias, e entrarei nas suas pousadas extremas, até no bosque do seu campo fértil.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י קַ֔רְתִּי וְשָׁתִ֖יתִי מַ֣יִם זָרִ֑ים וְאַחְרִב֙ בְּכַף־ פְּעָמַ֔י כֹּ֖ל יְאֹרֵ֥י מָצֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî qar·tî wə·šā·ṯî·ṯî ma·yim zā·rîm wə·’aḥ·riḇ bə·ḵap̄- pə·‘ā·may kōl yə·’ō·rê mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Eu cavei, e bebi águas estranhas; e com as plantas de meus pés sequei todos os rios do Egito.

verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֤עְתָּ לְמֵֽרָחוֹק֙ אֹתָ֣הּ עָשִׂ֔יתִי לְמִ֥ימֵי קֶ֖דֶם וִֽיצַרְתִּ֑יהָ עַתָּ֣ה הֲבֵיאתִ֗יהָ וּתְהִ֗י לַהְשׁ֛וֹת גַּלִּ֥ים נִצִּ֖ים עָרִ֥ים בְּצֻרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- šā·ma‘·tā lə·mê·rā·ḥō·wq ’ō·ṯāh ‘ā·śî·ṯî lə·mî·mê qe·ḏem wî·ṣar·tî·hā ‘at·tāh hă·ḇê·ṯî·hā ū·ṯə·hî lah·šō·wṯ gal·lîm niṣ·ṣîm ‘ā·rîm bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Have you not heard Long ago I ordained it in days of old I planned it Now I have brought it to pass that you should crush . . . fortified cities into piles of rubble
verses.literalPt: Porventura não ouviste que já dantes fiz isto, e já desde os dias antigos o planejei? Agora, porém, o fiz vir, para que fosses tu que reduzisses as cidades fortificadas a montões desertos.

verses.original: וְיֹֽשְׁבֵיהֶן֙ קִצְרֵי־ יָ֔ד חַ֖תּוּ וַיֵּבֹ֑שׁוּ הָי֞וּ עֵ֤שֶׂב שָׂדֶה֙ וִ֣ירַק דֶּ֔שֶׁא חֲצִ֣יר גַּגּ֔וֹת וּשְׁדֵפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י קָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·šə·ḇê·hen qiṣ·rê- yāḏ ḥat·tū way·yê·ḇō·šū hā·yū ‘ê·śeḇ śā·ḏeh wî·raq de·še ḥă·ṣîr gag·gō·wṯ ū·šə·ḏê·p̄āh lip̄·nê qā·māh
verses.literal: Therefore their inhabitants devoid of power are dismayed and ashamed They are like plants in the field tender green shoots grass on the rooftops scorched before it is grown
verses.literalPt: Por isso os moradores delas, com pouca força, ficaram pasmados e confundidos; eram como a erva do campo, e a hortaliça verde, e o feno dos telhados, e o trigo queimado, antes de amadurecer.

verses.original: וְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ וְצֵאתְךָ֥ וּבֹאֲךָ֖ יָדָ֑עְתִּי וְאֵ֖ת הִֽתְרַגֶּזְךָ֥ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šiḇ·tə·ḵā wə·ṣê·ṯə·ḵā ū·ḇō·’ă·ḵā yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî wə·’êṯ hiṯ·rag·gez·ḵā ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: But I know your sitting down your going out and coming in and your raging against Me
verses.literalPt: Porém o teu assentar, e o teu sair e o teu entrar, e o teu furor contra mim, eu o sei.

verses.original: יַ֚עַן הִתְרַגֶּזְךָ֣ אֵלַ֔י וְשַׁאֲנַנְךָ֖ עָלָ֣ה בְאָזְנָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י חַחִ֜י בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ וּמִתְגִּי֙ בִּשְׂפָתֶ֔יךָ וַהֲשִׁ֣בֹתִ֔יךָ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אתָ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an hiṯ·rag·gez·ḵā ’ê·lay wə·ša·’ă·nan·ḵā ‘ā·lāh ḇə·’ā·zə·nāy wə·śam·tî ḥa·ḥî bə·’ap·pe·ḵā ū·miṯ·gî biś·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî·ḵā bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- bā·ṯā bāh
verses.literal: Because your rage and arrogance against Me have reached My ears I will put My hook in your nose and My bit in your mouth I will send you back the way you came
verses.literalPt: Por causa do teu furor contra mim, e porque a tua revolta subiu aos meus ouvidos, portanto porei o meu anzol no teu nariz e o meu freio nos teus lábios, e te farei voltar pelo caminho por onde vieste.

verses.original: וְזֶה־ לְּךָ֣ הָא֔וֹת אָכ֤וֹל הַשָּׁנָה֙ סָפִ֔יחַ וּבַשָּׁנָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית סָחִ֑ישׁ וּבַשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗ית זִרְע֧וּ וְקִצְר֛וּ וְנִטְע֥וּ כְרָמִ֖ים וְאִכְל֥וּ פִרְיָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh- lə·ḵā hā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·ḵō·wl haš·šā·nāh sā·p̄î·aḥ ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh haš·šê·nîṯ sā·ḥîš ū·ḇaš·šā·nāh haš·šə·lî·šîṯ zir·‘ū wə·qiṣ·rū wə·niṭ·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm wə·’iḵ·lū p̄ir·yām
verses.literal: And this will be a sign to you, O Hezekiah This year you will eat what grows on its own and in the second year what springs from the same But in the third year you will sow and reap you will plant vineyards and eat their fruit
verses.literalPt: E isto te será por sinal; este ano se comerá o que nascer por si mesmo, e no ano seguinte o que daí proceder; porém, no terceiro ano semeai e segai, plantai vinhas, e comei os seus frutos.

verses.original: וְיָ֨סְפָ֜ה פְּלֵיטַ֧ת בֵּית־ יְהוּדָ֛ה הַנִּשְׁאָרָ֖ה שֹׁ֣רֶשׁ לְמָ֑טָּה וְעָשָׂ֥ה פְרִ֖י לְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·sə·p̄āh pə·lê·ṭaṯ bêṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh han·niš·’ā·rāh šō·reš lə·māṭ·ṭāh wə·‘ā·śāh p̄ə·rî lə·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: And the surviving remnant of the house of Judah will again take root below and bear fruit above
verses.literalPt: Porque o que escapou da casa de Judá, e restou, tornará a lançar raízes para baixo, e dará fruto para cima.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִירוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ תֵּצֵ֣א שְׁאֵרִ֔ית וּפְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵהַ֣ר צִיּ֑וֹן קִנְאַ֛ת יְהוָ֥הֳ֖ תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ זֹּֽאת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî mî·rū·šā·lim tê·ṣê šə·’ê·rîṯ ū·p̄ə·lê·ṭāh mê·har ṣî·yō·wn qin·’aṯ ha·šēm ta·‘ă·śeh- zōṯ
verses.literal: For a remnant will go forth from Jerusalem and survivors from Mount Zion The zeal of the LORD of Hosts will accomplish this
verses.literalPt: Porque de Jerusalém sairá o restante, e do monte Sião o que escapou; o zelo do SENHOR dos Exércitos fará isto.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר לֹ֤א יָבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֔את וְלֹֽא־ יוֹרֶ֥ה שָׁ֖ם חֵ֑ץ וְלֹֽא־ יְקַדְּמֶ֣נָּה מָגֵ֔ן וְלֹֽא־ יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ עָלֶ֖יהָ סֹלְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- me·leḵ ’aš·šūr lō yā·ḇō ’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ wə·lō- yō·w·reh šām ḥêṣ wə·lō- yə·qad·də·men·nāh mā·ḡên wə·lō- yiš·pōḵ ‘ā·le·hā sō·lə·lāh
verses.literal: So this is what the LORD says about the king of Assyria He will not enter . . . this city or shoot an arrow into it He will not come before it with a shield or build up a siege ramp against it
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o SENHOR acerca do rei da Assíria: Não entrará nesta cidade, nem lançará nela flecha alguma; tampouco virá perante ela com escudo, nem levantará contra ela trincheira alguma.

verses.original: בַּדֶּ֥רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־ יָבֹ֖א בָּ֣הּ יָשׁ֑וּב וְאֶל־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֛את לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer- yā·ḇō bāh yā·šūḇ wə·’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lō yā·ḇō nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: He will go back the way he came and he will not enter . . . this city declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Pelo caminho por onde vier, por ele voltará; porém nesta cidade não entrará, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְגַנּוֹתִ֛י אֶל־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את לְהֽוֹשִׁיעָ֑הּ לְמַֽעֲנִ֔י וּלְמַ֖עַן דָּוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡan·nō·w·ṯî ’el- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ lə·hō·wō·šî·‘āh lə·ma·‘ă·nî ū·lə·ma·‘an dā·wiḏ ‘aḇ·dî
verses.literal: I will defend . . . this city and save it for My own sake and for the sake of My servant David
verses.literalPt: Porque eu ampararei a esta cidade, para a livrar, por amor de mim e por amor do meu servo Davi.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֮ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַהוּא֒ וַיֵּצֵ֣א׀ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַיַּךְ֙ בְּמַחֲנֵ֣ה אַשּׁ֔וּר מֵאָ֛ה שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אָ֑לֶף וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וְהִנֵּ֥ה כֻלָּ֖ם פְּגָרִ֥ים מֵתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bal·lay·lāh ha·hū way·yê·ṣê mal·’aḵ Yah·weh way·yaḵ bə·ma·ḥă·nêh ’aš·šūr mê·’āh šə·mō·w·nîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ’ā·lep̄ way·yaš·kî·mū ḇab·bō·qer wə·hin·nêh ḵul·lām pə·ḡā·rîm mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: And that very night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men . . . . . . . . . in the camp of the Assyrians When the people got up the next morning there were all the dead bodies
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que naquela mesma noite saiu o anjo do SENHOR, e feriu no arraial dos assírios a cento e oitenta e cinco mil deles; e, levantando-se pela manhã cedo, eis que todos eram cadáveres.

verses.original: וַיִּסַּ֣ע וַיֵּ֔לֶךְ וַיָּ֖שָׁב סַנְחֵרִ֣יב מֶֽלֶךְ־ אַשּׁ֑וּר וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בְּנִֽינְוֵֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sa‘ way·yê·leḵ way·yā·šāḇ san·ḥê·rîḇ me·leḵ- ’aš·šūr way·yê·šeḇ bə·nî·nə·wêh
verses.literal: So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew He returned to Nineveh and stayed there
verses.literalPt: Então Senaqueribe, rei da Assíria, partiu, e se foi, e voltou e ficou em Nínive.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ ה֨וּא מִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֜ה בֵּ֣ית׀ נִסְרֹ֣ךְ אֱלֹהָ֗יו וְֽאַדְרַמֶּ֨לֶךְ וְשַׂרְאֶ֤צֶרָָ֙ הִכֻּ֣הוּ בַחֶ֔רֶב וְהֵ֥מָּה נִמְלְט֖וּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֲרָרָ֑ט וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אֵֽסַר־ חַדֹּ֥ן בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî hū miš·ta·ḥă·weh bêṯ nis·rōḵ ’ĕ·lō·hāw wə·’aḏ·ram·me·leḵ wə·śar·ʾɛ·ṣɛ·rå̄ hik·ku·hū ḇa·ḥe·reḇ wə·hêm·māh nim·lə·ṭū ’e·reṣ ’ă·rā·rāṭ way·yim·lōḵ ’ê·sar- ḥad·dōn bə·nōw taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: One day while he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to the sword . . . and escaped to the land of Ararat And his son Esar-haddon . . . reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, estando ele prostrado na casa de Nisroque, seu deus, Adrameleque e Sarezer, seus filhos, o feriram à espada; porém eles escaparam para a terra de Ararate; e Esar-Hadom, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
